div.name: disclosure
div.p: Connecting lets Odoo read and change the contacts in your Google account, so your Odoo contacts and your Google contacts stay in step.

ul.li: What Odoo reads: your Google contacts and labels. Only contacts under the label your administrator chooses come into Odoo.
What Odoo changes: it creates and updates Google contacts for your Odoo contacts and adds them to that label. It deletes a Google contact only if your administrator has turned deleting on.

Where your contacts go: only into this Odoo database. ThriveWell Connect, the ThriveWell service that signs you in to Google, keeps your sign-in and never your contacts. Your contacts are never sold or used for advertising.
How to stop: press Disconnect in your preferences. Odoo gives the sign-in back and Google removes the access. You can also remove it in your Google Account, under Security, Third-party apps.

div.p: ThriveWell's use of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
div.div: On Google's screen, tick the box beside the Contacts permission. Without it, nothing connects.
